responsibility: Defines RTL machine-description patterns for T-Head vendor extensions such as XTheadBa/Bb/Bs, conditional move, floating-point move helpers, multiply-accumulate forms, and XTheadMemPair instructions. It maps GCC RTL to these nonstandard instructions and delegates operand validation/output details for mempair cases to helpers in thead.cc, making it the instruction-pattern half of T-Head extension support.
same_name_distinction: Within the `thead` pair, this `.md` file defines the RTL instruction patterns for T-Head vendor extensions, including arithmetic/bitmanip forms, conditional moves, FMV helpers, MAC patterns, and mempair insns. Unlike `thead.cc`, it is the declarative machine-description side and relies on helper routines there for mempair operand checks and final asm emission.
